To: All Marketing Staff
From: Renata Okafor, Office Manager
Subject: Temporary relocation of the third-floor copy room
Date: March 4

Dear colleagues,

Beginning Monday, March 9, the copy room on the third floor will be closed for approximately three weeks while new ventilation ducts are installed. During this period, all printing and copying equipment will be moved to Room 214 on the second floor. The room is smaller than our current space, so we ask that large print jobs of more than 200 pages be sent to the external print shop, Davenport Printing, with which we have a corporate account. Order forms are available on the company intranet under "Vendor Services."

Please note that the color printer will not be available at all during the construction period because it requires a dedicated power line that Room 214 does not have. If you need color materials for client presentations, contact my assistant, Theo Lim, at least two business days in advance, and he will arrange outside printing for you.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
Renata Okafor

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: To announce the purchase of new printing equipment
To inform employees about a temporary change to a facility
To request volunteers for an office renovation project
To introduce a new office manager to the staff
questions.explanation: 이메일의 첫 문단에서 3층 복사실이 환기 덕트 설치 공사로 약 3주간 폐쇄되고 장비가 2층 214호로 임시 이전된다고 알리고 있습니다. 즉, 시설의 일시적 변경을 직원들에게 공지하는 것이 주된 목적입니다. 새 장비 구매(A), 자원봉사자 모집(C), 신임 관리자 소개(D)에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: What are employees asked to do with print jobs over 200 pages?
options: Submit them before March 9
Divide them into smaller batches
Send them to an outside printing company
Get approval from the office manager
questions.explanation: 본문에서 "large print jobs of more than 200 pages be sent to the external print shop, Davenport Printing"이라고 명시하여, 200페이지가 넘는 대형 인쇄 작업은 법인 계약이 되어 있는 외부 인쇄소로 보내 달라고 요청하고 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 (C)입니다.

questions.question: Why will the color printer be unavailable?
options: It is scheduled to be replaced with a newer model.
The temporary room lacks a suitable power supply.
It was damaged during the relocation process.
Repair technicians are not available until April.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 컬러 프린터는 전용 전력선(a dedicated power line)이 필요한데 임시 공간인 214호에는 그것이 없기 때문에 공사 기간 내내 사용할 수 없다고 설명합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 교체, 파손, 수리 기사 부재는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What should an employee who needs color presentation materials do?
options: Contact Theo Lim at least two business days ahead
Use the printer in Room 214
Fill out a form at Davenport Printing's office
Postpone the presentation until construction ends
questions.explanation: 마지막 문단에서 고객 프레젠테이션용 컬러 자료가 필요한 경우 최소 영업일 기준 2일 전에 비서인 Theo Lim에게 연락하면 외부 인쇄를 주선해 준다고 안내합니다. 따라서 정답은 (A)입니다. 214호에는 컬러 프린터가 없으므로 (B)는 오답입니다.

To: Hannah Brodeur <hbrodeur@castellanhotels.com>
From: Marcus Webb <m.webb@trionlogistics.com>
Subject: Re: Conference room booking — April 18
Date: March 27

Dear Ms. Brodeur,

Thank you for confirming our reservation of the Lakeview Conference Suite for Friday, April 18. I am writing because our circumstances have changed slightly. We originally booked the room for 25 attendees, but our regional partners have now confirmed that they will join us, bringing the total to approximately 40 people.

Could you let me know whether the Lakeview Suite can accommodate this larger group? If not, I understand from your Web site that the Grandview Hall holds up to 60 guests. We would be willing to upgrade if the price difference is reasonable. We would also like to add a buffet lunch to our package; previously we had requested only morning coffee service.

Finally, two of our presenters will arrive the evening before the event. Could you reserve two single rooms for the night of April 17 at the corporate rate we discussed last year?

I would appreciate a revised quotation by the end of this week, as I must submit the budget to our finance team on Monday.

Sincerely,
Marcus Webb, Event Coordinator, Trion Logistics

To complain about a billing error
To request changes to an existing booking
To confirm the attendance of regional partners at a dinner
questions.explanation: Webb 씨는 이미 예약이 확정된 회의실에 대해 참석 인원 증가(25명→약 40명), 점심 뷔페 추가, 발표자 숙박 예약 등 기존 예약 내용의 변경을 요청하기 위해 이메일을 보냈습니다. 예약 취소(A)나 청구 오류 항의(B)가 아니므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

It does not offer buffet service.
questions.explanation: Webb 씨는 Lakeview Suite가 40명을 수용하지 못할 경우 최대 60명을 수용할 수 있는 Grandview Hall로 업그레이드할 의향이 있다고 말합니다. 이는 Grandview Hall이 Lakeview Suite보다 더 많은 인원을 수용할 수 있음을 시사하므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 위치, 보수 공사, 뷔페 제공 여부는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Webb ask Ms. Brodeur to arrange for April 17?
options: A buffet lunch for 40 guests
Morning coffee service
Hotel accommodations for two presenters
Transportation from the airport
questions.explanation: 이메일 세 번째 문단에서 발표자 두 명이 행사 전날 저녁에 도착하므로 4월 17일 밤에 묵을 싱글룸 두 개를 작년에 논의한 법인 요금으로 예약해 달라고 요청합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 뷔페 점심은 행사 당일인 4월 18일에 해당합니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Webb need the revised quotation by the end of the week?
options: He must present a budget to the finance team on Monday.
The hotel's corporate rate expires soon.
His regional partners require immediate confirmation.
The event date may need to be moved.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문단에서 월요일에 재무팀(finance team)에 예산을 제출해야 하므로 이번 주말까지 수정 견적서를 보내 달라고 요청하고 있습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 법인 요금 만료, 파트너의 확인 요구, 행사 날짜 변경은 본문에 없는 내용입니다.

Subject: Your order #VL-88213

To: All Tenants, Harborline Business Center
From: Property Management Office
Subject: Annual fire safety inspection — action required
Date: September 30

Dear Tenants,

As required by city regulations, the annual fire safety inspection of Harborline Business Center will take place on Thursday, October 16, between 9:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M. Inspectors from the city fire department, accompanied by a member of our management staff, will need to enter every office suite to test smoke detectors, check fire extinguishers, and confirm that emergency exits are unobstructed.

To prepare, please make sure that nothing is stored within one meter of any exit door or electrical panel and that corridors leading to stairwells remain clear. Last year, several suites failed the initial inspection because boxes were stacked in front of exit doors, and the follow-up visits delayed certification for the entire building by three weeks.

If your suite will be unoccupied on October 16, you must either leave a key with the management office by October 14 or arrange for a staff member to be present. Suites that cannot be accessed will be scheduled for a separate inspection, and the $150 re-inspection fee charged by the city will be passed on to the tenant.

Questions may be directed to the management office at extension 2200.

Harborline Property Management

questions.question: What is the purpose of the email?
options: To announce changes to the building's emergency exits
To prepare tenants for an upcoming inspection
To report the results of a recent fire drill
To explain an increase in monthly rent
questions.explanation: 이메일은 10월 16일에 실시될 연례 소방 안전 점검을 공지하고, 이에 대비해 입주사들이 해야 할 준비 사항(출입문 주변 정리, 열쇠 제출 등)을 안내하고 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 비상구 변경, 소방 훈련 결과 보고, 임대료 인상은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the email, what caused a delay last year?
options: A shortage of city inspectors
Faulty smoke detectors in several suites
Items blocking exit doors in some offices
A scheduling error by the management office
questions.explanation: 두 번째 문단에서 작년에 여러 사무실이 출입문 앞에 상자를 쌓아 두어 1차 점검에서 불합격했고, 그로 인한 재방문 때문에 건물 전체의 인증이 3주 지연되었다고 설명합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What must tenants do if no one will be in their office on October 16?
options: Pay a $150 fee in advance
Reschedule the inspection online
Leave a key with management or have a staff member present
Post a notice on their office door
questions.explanation: 세 번째 문단에서 10월 16일에 사무실이 비어 있을 경우 10월 14일까지 관리사무소에 열쇠를 맡기거나 직원이 상주하도록 조치해야 한다고 명시합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. $150는 출입이 불가능해 별도 재점검을 받게 될 경우 부과되는 수수료입니다.

questions.question: The word "passed on" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
options: delivered physically
transferred as a charge
approved officially
ignored deliberately
questions.explanation: "the $150 re-inspection fee ... will be passed on to the tenant"에서 'passed on'은 시에서 부과한 재점검 수수료를 입주사에게 비용으로 전가한다는 의미입니다. 따라서 '요금으로 이전되다'라는 (B)가 가장 가깝습니다. 물리적 전달(A)이나 공식 승인(C)의 의미가 아닙니다.

To: Daniel Mercer <d.mercer@brightpath.org>
From: Ingrid Solberg <isolberg@northwindmedia.ca>
Subject: Speaking invitation — Brightpath Annual Forum
Date: January 22

Dear Mr. Mercer,

Thank you very much for inviting me to deliver the keynote address at the Brightpath Annual Forum on May 8 in Toronto. I am honored by the invitation, and the theme you described — building community partnerships in the digital age — aligns closely with the research my team published last autumn.

Before I accept, I would like to clarify a few practical matters. First, your message mentioned a 45-minute session; could you confirm whether this includes time for audience questions, or whether a separate question period will follow? Second, I will be traveling from Vancouver, and my schedule that week is quite tight. I could arrive on the morning of May 8, but only if my session is scheduled after 1:00 P.M. If you need me in the morning, I would have to fly in the previous day, in which case I would ask that the forum cover one night's accommodation.

Lastly, you asked whether I could also lead a workshop on May 9. Unfortunately, I must return to Vancouver that evening for a board meeting on the morning of May 10, so I will have to decline that part of the invitation.

I look forward to your reply.

Warm regards,
Ingrid Solberg, Director of Research, Northwind Media

questions.question: Why did Ms. Solberg write to Mr. Mercer?
options: To decline an invitation to a forum
To ask questions before accepting an invitation
To propose a new theme for a conference
To request a copy of published research
questions.explanation: Solberg 씨는 기조연설 초청에 영광이라고 하면서도 수락하기 전에(Before I accept) 세션 시간 구성, 일정, 숙박 등 실무적인 사항을 확인하고자 이메일을 썼습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 기조연설 자체를 거절한 것이 아니며, 거절한 것은 5월 9일 워크숍뿐입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Solberg ask about the 45-minute session?
options: Whether it can be extended to one hour
Whether it includes time for audience questions
Whether it will be recorded for later viewing
Whether she can present with a colleague
questions.explanation: 두 번째 문단에서 45분 세션에 청중 질의 시간이 포함되는지, 아니면 별도의 질의 시간이 이어지는지 확인해 달라고 요청합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 시간 연장, 녹화, 공동 발표는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: Under what condition would Ms. Solberg request accommodation?
options: If her session is scheduled in the morning
If the forum is moved to Vancouver
If the workshop on May 9 is confirmed
If her flight from Vancouver is delayed
questions.explanation: Solberg 씨는 세션이 오후 1시 이후라면 당일 아침에 도착할 수 있지만, 오전에 필요하다면 전날 미리 와야 하므로 그 경우 1박 숙박비를 포럼 측이 부담해 줄 것을 요청하겠다고 말합니다. 즉, 오전 세션으로 배정될 경우가 조건이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Solberg unable to lead the workshop on May 9?
options: She will be attending another conference.
She must return home for a board meeting.
She has not prepared workshop materials.
Her research team needs her in Toronto.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문단에서 5월 10일 오전 이사회(board meeting) 참석을 위해 5월 9일 저녁에 밴쿠버로 돌아가야 하므로 워크숍 진행은 거절할 수밖에 없다고 설명합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

To: Service Team <service@kestrelappliance.com>
From: Omar Haddad <ohaddad@plumeriacafe.com>
Subject: Repeated problem with refrigerator unit
Date: August 11

To whom it may concern,

I am the owner of Plumeria Café on Welland Street, and I am writing about the commercial refrigerator (model KR-450) that your company installed in our kitchen fourteen months ago. Three weeks ago, the unit began making a loud rattling noise, and the internal temperature rose above the safe range overnight, forcing us to discard a significant amount of dairy stock. Your technician, Mr. Boyle, visited on July 24 and replaced the compressor fan. However, the same problem returned last Friday, and we lost more inventory over the weekend.

I contacted your call center on Saturday and was told that the earliest available appointment was August 19. For a business that depends on refrigeration, waiting more than a week is simply not acceptable. Furthermore, since the unit is still under its two-year warranty and the July repair clearly did not resolve the issue, I believe we should not be charged the second call-out fee that appeared on the invoice e-mailed to me yesterday.

I request that you send a technician within the next two business days and that the $95 fee be removed from our account. If the unit cannot be permanently repaired, I would like to discuss a replacement under the terms of the warranty.

Sincerely,
Omar Haddad, Owner, Plumeria Café

questions.question: Why did Mr. Haddad write the email?
options: To order a new refrigerator for his café
To complain about an unresolved equipment problem
To compliment a technician on a recent repair
To inquire about extending a warranty
questions.explanation: Haddad 씨는 7월에 수리를 받았음에도 냉장고 문제가 재발하여 재고 손실이 발생했고, 빠른 재방문과 수수료 취소를 요구하기 위해 이메일을 썼습니다. 즉, 해결되지 않은 장비 문제에 대한 항의이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What happened on July 24?
options: The refrigerator was first installed.
A technician replaced a part in the unit.
Mr. Haddad purchased additional dairy stock.
The warranty on the unit expired.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 7월 24일에 기술자 Boyle 씨가 방문하여 압축기 팬(compressor fan)을 교체했다고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 설치는 14개월 전이며, 보증 기간은 2년이므로 아직 유효합니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Haddad believe he should not pay the $95 fee?
options: He was promised free service when he bought the unit.
The first repair under warranty failed to fix the problem.
The technician arrived later than scheduled.
The fee was higher than the advertised rate.
questions.explanation: Haddad 씨는 냉장고가 아직 2년 보증 기간 내에 있고 7월의 수리가 문제를 해결하지 못한 것이 명백하므로 두 번째 출장 수수료를 부과해서는 안 된다고 주장합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Haddad say he wants to discuss if the unit cannot be fixed?
options: A refund of the original purchase price
Compensation for lost inventory
A replacement under the warranty
A discount on a larger model
questions.explanation: 마지막 문단에서 냉장고를 영구적으로 수리할 수 없다면 보증 조건에 따른 교체(replacement under the terms of the warranty)에 대해 논의하고 싶다고 밝힙니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 환불이나 재고 손실 보상, 더 큰 모델 할인은 요청 사항에 없습니다.

questions.question: Where most likely does Ms. Park work?
options: At a delivery truck company
At a warehouse that supplies stores
At the Fairmont Street store
At a garden landscaping firm
questions.explanation: Park 씨는 "The delivery truck just left our warehouse"라고 말하며 매장 재입고 주문의 배송 일정과 물량을 관리하고 있습니다. 이는 그녀가 매장에 물건을 공급하는 창고(물류) 쪽에서 일한다는 것을 시사하므로 (B)가 정답입니다. Fairmont Street 매장에 있는 사람은 Castillo 씨입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Castillo mention?
options: His store has limited storage space.
A delivery truck has broken down.
Several garden tools arrived damaged.
The weekend promotion was canceled.
questions.explanation: Castillo 씨는 주말 세일에서 재고가 기대만큼 팔리지 않아 창고(back room)가 거의 가득 찼다고 말하고, 팔레트 4개는 빠듯할 것 같다고 우려합니다. 즉, 보관 공간 부족이 문제이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Park say the planters cannot go to the Oakdale branch?
options: The Oakdale branch did not order any planters.
Rerouting the truck would delay an urgent delivery.
The planters were specially requested by a customer.
The Oakdale branch is closed for renovations.
questions.explanation: Park 씨는 트럭이 이미 고속도로에 올라 있어 지금 경로를 변경하면 주말 프로모션에 긴급히 필요한 원예 도구의 배송이 다음 날로 밀린다고 설명합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 10:15 A.M., what does Ms. Park most likely mean when she writes, "Consider it done"?
options: She has already updated the delivery schedule.
She agrees to delay next week's shipment.
She will send the planters to another branch.
She has finished loading the truck.
questions.explanation: 바로 앞에서 Castillo 씨가 다음 주 배송을 수요일까지 보류해 달라고 요청했고, Park 씨가 "Consider it done(그렇게 처리된 걸로 생각하세요)"이라고 답했습니다. 이는 다음 주 배송 연기 요청을 수락하겠다는 의미이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 일정 변경은 자리에 돌아가서 하겠다고 했으므로 아직 완료된 것은 아닙니다(A는 오답).

passage:
Aiko Tanaka (2:30 P.M.)
Hi Ben, quick question. The client from Sellars Group just called. They want to move tomorrow's product demo from 10 A.M. to 8:30 A.M. Can you make that work?

Ben Whitfield (2:34 P.M.)
That's cutting it close. The demo laptops are still with the IT team for the software update. They told me pickup would be at 9.

Aiko Tanaka (2:36 P.M.)
Could we ask IT to finish earlier? The client's vice president is flying out at noon, so the earlier slot is the only time he can attend.

Ben Whitfield (2:39 P.M.)
Let me check with Dana in IT. She owes me a favor.

Aiko Tanaka (2:40 P.M.)
Fingers crossed.

Ben Whitfield (2:52 P.M.)
Good news. Dana says the laptops will be ready by 7:45 tomorrow morning. But she can't deliver them — one of us has to pick them up from the fifth floor.

Aiko Tanaka (2:54 P.M.)
I'll handle that. I'm usually in by 7:30 anyway. Can you set up the demo room and test the projector when you arrive?

Ben Whitfield (2:56 P.M.)
Will do. I'll also print extra copies of the spec sheets in case the VP brings his team.

Aiko Tanaka (2:57 P.M.)
Great thinking. See you bright and early.

questions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: Rescheduling a product demonstration
Repairing some broken laptops
Hiring a new IT staff member
Planning a client's farewell party
questions.explanation: 대화는 Sellars Group 고객의 요청으로 다음 날 오전 10시 제품 시연을 8시 30분으로 앞당기는 문제와 그에 따른 준비(노트북 수령, 시연실 준비 등)를 논의하고 있습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does the client want an earlier meeting time?
options: The meeting room is unavailable at 10 A.M.
An executive must leave for a flight at noon.
The client's office closes early tomorrow.
Another demo is scheduled for the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Tanaka 씨는 고객사 부사장이 정오에 비행기로 떠나기 때문에 이른 시간대가 그가 참석할 수 있는 유일한 시간이라고 설명합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 2:39 P.M., what does Mr. Whitfield most likely mean when he writes, "She owes me a favor"?
options: He thinks Dana will agree to help them.
He lent Dana some money recently.
He believes Dana caused the scheduling problem.
He expects Dana to attend the demo.
questions.explanation: IT팀에 작업을 앞당겨 달라고 요청해야 하는 상황에서 Whitfield 씨가 "Dana가 나한테 신세 진 게 있다"고 말한 것은, 그 인연 덕분에 Dana가 부탁을 들어줄 가능성이 높다고 생각한다는 의미입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 실제로 Dana는 노트북을 7시 45분까지 준비해 주기로 합니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Tanaka offer to do?
options: Print extra spec sheets
Test the projector in the demo room
Pick up the laptops from the fifth floor
Call the client to confirm the new time
questions.explanation: Dana가 노트북을 배달해 줄 수 없어 둘 중 한 명이 5층에서 수령해야 한다고 하자, Tanaka 씨가 "I'll handle that"이라며 평소 7시 30분까지 출근하니 자신이 수령하겠다고 합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 자료 인쇄와 프로젝터 점검은 Whitfield 씨가 맡았습니다.

passage:
Claire Dubois (4:05 P.M.)
Team, the caterer for Friday's retirement reception just informed me they double-booked and have to cancel. We have 60 guests confirmed. Ideas?

Raj Patel (4:08 P.M.)
That's only two days away! What about Lemon & Thyme on Carter Avenue? They catered our holiday party.

Claire Dubois (4:10 P.M.)
I called them first. They can't take an order that size on such short notice.

Sofia Marino (4:12 P.M.)
My cousin manages Verde Bistro. They do corporate events. Want me to ask if they're free Friday?

Claire Dubois (4:13 P.M.)
Please do. We'd need appetizers and a dessert table for 60, delivered by 4:30.

Raj Patel (4:15 P.M.)
In the worst case, we could order trays from the supermarket deli and pick them up ourselves. Not fancy, but it would work.

Claire Dubois (4:17 P.M.)
Let's keep that in our back pocket.

Sofia Marino (4:31 P.M.)
Good news! Verde Bistro can do it. Their event menu is $22 per person, and delivery is free for orders over $1,000. They just need a signed agreement by tomorrow at noon.

Claire Dubois (4:33 P.M.)
Wonderful. Send me the contact details and I'll get the paperwork started tonight.

questions.question: What problem is the team discussing?
options: A retirement reception has too many guests.
A caterer canceled an order at short notice.
A reception venue is no longer available.
A budget for an event was reduced.
questions.explanation: Dubois 씨의 첫 메시지에서 금요일 은퇴 기념 행사의 케이터링 업체가 이중 예약으로 취소를 통보했다고 알리고 있습니다. 행사 이틀 전에 발생한 케이터링 취소가 문제이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Lemon & Thyme?
options: It is unable to handle the order in time.
It charges more than Verde Bistro.
It is located far from the office.
It no longer offers catering services.
questions.explanation: Patel 씨가 Lemon & Thyme을 제안하자 Dubois 씨는 이미 전화해 봤는데 촉박한 일정에 그 규모의 주문은 받을 수 없다고 했다고 답합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 가격, 위치, 케이터링 중단 여부는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: At 4:17 P.M., what does Ms. Dubois most likely mean when she writes, "Let's keep that in our back pocket"?
options: She wants to keep the deli idea as a backup plan.
She thinks the supermarket option is too expensive.
She has already ordered trays from the deli.
She wants Mr. Patel to keep the plan secret.
questions.explanation: Patel 씨가 최악의 경우 슈퍼마켓 델리에서 음식 트레이를 사 오자고 제안하자 Dubois 씨가 "그건 비상용으로 남겨 두자"라고 답했습니다. 'keep ~ in one's back pocket'은 예비 방안으로 보관해 둔다는 관용 표현이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What must be done by noon tomorrow?
options: A signed agreement must be returned to Verde Bistro.
The guest list must be finalized.
A deposit of $1,000 must be paid.
The dessert menu must be selected.
questions.explanation: Marino 씨의 4시 31분 메시지에서 Verde Bistro가 행사를 맡을 수 있지만 내일 정오까지 서명된 계약서(a signed agreement)가 필요하다고 전합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. $1,000는 무료 배송 기준 금액이지 보증금이 아닙니다.

passage:
Tom Eriksen (11:40 A.M.)
Hi Yuki, I'm at the trade show booth. We've already run out of the product brochures, and it's not even noon.

Yuki Nakamura (11:42 A.M.)
Already? We sent 500 with you. How's traffic at the booth?

Tom Eriksen (11:44 A.M.)
Nonstop. The new sensor demo is drawing a crowd. Two distributors asked about bulk pricing, and a reporter from Tech Current wants an interview with someone from headquarters.

Yuki Nakamura (11:46 A.M.)
That's fantastic. For the brochures, there's a print shop inside the convention center, level B. Send them the PDF from the shared drive and charge it to the corporate card.

Tom Eriksen (11:48 A.M.)
On it. How many should I order?

Yuki Nakamura (11:50 A.M.)
Go big. We still have two full days here.

Tom Eriksen (11:51 A.M.)
I'll ask for 800 then. What about the interview request?

Yuki Nakamura (11:53 A.M.)
Forward the reporter's details to Ms. Vasquez in communications. She handles all press contacts, and she's actually flying in tonight for tomorrow's panel.

Tom Eriksen (11:55 A.M.)
Perfect, the reporter will be happy to hear that. Sending the info now.

questions.question: Where most likely is Mr. Eriksen?
options: At a print shop
At a company booth at a trade show
At the company's headquarters
At a television studio
questions.explanation: Eriksen 씨의 첫 메시지 "I'm at the trade show booth"에서 그가 무역 박람회의 회사 부스에 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 인쇄소는 그가 브로슈어를 추가 주문하러 갈 곳입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Eriksen report?
options: The sensor demo is not working properly.
The booth's location is hard to find.
Promotional materials have run out.
A distributor canceled a meeting.
questions.explanation: Eriksen 씨는 정오도 되기 전에 제품 브로슈어 500부가 모두 소진되었다고 보고합니다. 홍보 자료가 떨어진 것이 문제이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 센서 시연은 오히려 인파를 끌고 있다고 했습니다.

questions.question: At 11:50 A.M., what does Ms. Nakamura most likely mean when she writes, "Go big"?
options: Mr. Eriksen should order a large quantity of brochures.
Mr. Eriksen should move to a larger booth.
Mr. Eriksen should print posters instead of brochures.
Mr. Eriksen should negotiate a bigger discount.
questions.explanation: 브로슈어를 몇 부나 주문해야 하느냐는 질문에 Nakamura 씨가 "Go big(크게 가세요)"이라며 박람회가 이틀이나 남았다고 답합니다. 이는 넉넉한 수량을 주문하라는 의미이며, 실제로 Eriksen 씨는 800부를 주문하겠다고 합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Ms. Vasquez?
options: She will arrive at the trade show by tonight.
She designed the product brochures.
She works for Tech Current magazine.
She is Mr. Eriksen's direct supervisor.
questions.explanation: Nakamura 씨는 홍보팀의 Vasquez 씨가 모든 언론 접촉을 담당하며, 내일 패널 행사를 위해 오늘 밤 비행기로 들어온다(flying in tonight)고 말합니다. 즉, 그녀가 오늘 밤 박람회가 열리는 도시에 도착한다는 것을 알 수 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 그녀는 Tech Current 기자가 아니라 회사 홍보 담당자입니다.

passage:
Grace Onyango (8:12 A.M.)
Morning, Felix. I just got off the train and the Route 12 bus to the office isn't running — there's a sign saying the road is closed for repaving all week.

Felix Braun (8:14 A.M.)
Oh no. I drove in today, so I missed that. Do you want me to come get you? The station is only ten minutes from here.

Grace Onyango (8:15 A.M.)
That's kind, but you have the 8:30 budget call, don't you?

Felix Braun (8:17 A.M.)
Good point. It's with the regional director, so I'd better not step out.

Grace Onyango (8:18 A.M.)
No worries. There's a shuttle to the industrial park that stops near our building. I'll try that. Worst case, it's a 25-minute walk.

Felix Braun (8:20 A.M.)
Okay. Your 9 o'clock with the auditors — want me to push it back just in case?

Grace Onyango (8:21 A.M.)
Let's not touch it yet. The shuttle should get me there by 8:50.

Felix Braun (8:23 A.M.)
Understood. I'll set out the contract files in the small meeting room so everything's ready when you arrive.

Grace Onyango (8:24 A.M.)
You're a lifesaver. See you soon.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Onyango unable to take her usual bus?
options: The bus drivers are on strike.
A road is closed for resurfacing work.
She missed the last morning bus.
The bus route was permanently discontinued.
questions.explanation: Onyango 씨는 12번 버스가 운행하지 않으며, 도로가 일주일 내내 재포장 공사로 폐쇄된다는 안내문이 있다고 말합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 파업, 막차 놓침, 노선 영구 폐지는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Braun decide not to pick up Ms. Onyango?
options: His car is being repaired.
He has an important call at 8:30.
He is working from home today.
The train station is too far away.
questions.explanation: Braun 씨가 데리러 가겠다고 제안하자 Onyango 씨가 8시 30분 예산 회의(전화)가 있지 않느냐고 상기시키고, Braun 씨는 지역 이사와의 통화라 자리를 비우지 않는 게 좋겠다고 동의합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 8:21 A.M., what does Ms. Onyango most likely mean when she writes, "Let's not touch it yet"?
options: She does not want to reschedule the 9 o'clock meeting for now.
She wants Mr. Braun to leave the contract files alone.
She prefers not to take the shuttle bus.
She thinks the budget call should not be changed.
questions.explanation: Braun 씨가 9시 회계감사인들과의 회의를 미뤄 둘지 묻자 Onyango 씨가 "아직 건드리지 말자"고 답하며 셔틀로 8시 50분까지 도착할 수 있을 것이라고 말합니다. 즉, 당장은 9시 회의 일정을 변경하지 않겠다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Braun say he will do?
options: Prepare documents in a meeting room
Contact the auditors about a delay
Drive to the train station
Check the shuttle schedule
questions.explanation: 마지막 부분에서 Braun 씨는 Onyango 씨가 도착했을 때 모든 것이 준비되어 있도록 소회의실에 계약 서류(contract files)를 꺼내 두겠다고 말합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Liam O'Connor (3:20 P.M.)
Hi Dr. Reyes, this is Liam from Hartwell Publishing. I'm finalizing the layout for your book chapter, and I noticed the two figures you sent are lower resolution than our print standard. Could you resend them at 300 dpi or higher?

Elena Reyes (3:45 P.M.)
Hi Liam. I have the originals on my office computer, but I'm at a conference in Geneva until Thursday. How urgent is this?

Liam O'Connor (3:48 P.M.)
The full manuscript goes to the printer Monday morning. As long as I have the files by Friday noon, we're fine.

Elena Reyes (3:52 P.M.)
That works. I land Thursday evening, so I can send them first thing Friday. One thing — Figure 2 was made by my co-author, Dr. Mensah. He may have a higher-quality version than mine.

Liam O'Connor (3:55 P.M.)
Should I contact him directly? It might save you a step.

Elena Reyes (3:57 P.M.)
Be my guest. His email is on the title page of the manuscript. Tell him I sent you.

Liam O'Connor (3:59 P.M.)
Will do. And while I have you — the marketing team asked if you could provide a short author bio, around 100 words, for the back cover.

Elena Reyes (4:02 P.M.)
I can write that on the plane home. You'll have both the bio and Figure 1 by Friday.

Liam O'Connor (4:03 P.M.)
Perfect. Enjoy the rest of the conference!

questions.question: Why did Mr. O'Connor contact Dr. Reyes?
options: To ask her to review a printing contract
To request higher-quality image files
To invite her to a publishing conference
To inform her of a change in the publication date
questions.explanation: O'Connor 씨는 책 챕터의 레이아웃을 마무리하는 중 Reyes 박사가 보낸 그림 두 개의 해상도가 인쇄 기준에 못 미쳐 300dpi 이상으로 다시 보내 달라고 요청하기 위해 연락했습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Dr. Reyes unable to send the files immediately?
options: She is attending a conference abroad.
Her computer is being repaired.
She lost the original files.
She is waiting for her co-author's approval.
questions.explanation: Reyes 박사는 원본 파일이 사무실 컴퓨터에 있는데 목요일까지 제네바에서 열리는 학회에 참석 중이라 즉시 보낼 수 없다고 설명합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 3:57 P.M., what does Dr. Reyes most likely mean when she writes, "Be my guest"?
options: She gives Mr. O'Connor permission to contact Dr. Mensah.
She invites Mr. O'Connor to visit her in Geneva.
She wants Mr. O'Connor to wait until Friday.
She offers to host a book launch event.
questions.explanation: O'Connor 씨가 시간 절약을 위해 공저자인 Mensah 박사에게 직접 연락해도 되는지 묻자 Reyes 박사가 "Be my guest(그러세요/얼마든지요)"라고 답하며 이메일 주소 위치까지 알려 줍니다. 이는 직접 연락해도 좋다는 허락의 표현이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Dr. Reyes say she will do on her flight home?
options: Revise Figure 2
Write a short biography
Review the final manuscript
Email Dr. Mensah
questions.explanation: 마케팅팀이 뒤표지에 실을 100단어 분량의 저자 약력을 요청했다는 말에 Reyes 박사는 귀국 비행기에서 그것을 쓰겠다(I can write that on the plane home)고 답합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
GRAND OPENING — RIVERSTONE FITNESS CLUB

Riverstone Fitness Club opens its doors on Saturday, November 1, at 220 Mercer Boulevard, just two blocks from Central Station. Our 3,000-square-meter facility features the latest cardio and strength-training equipment, a 25-meter indoor pool, two studios offering more than 40 group classes per week, and a juice bar serving freshly made smoothies.

To celebrate our opening, the first 100 people who sign up for an annual membership will receive 20 percent off the regular rate plus three complimentary sessions with a certified personal trainer. This offer is valid only for memberships purchased at the club in person between November 1 and November 15.

Can't commit to a full year? Our flexible monthly plan has no joining fee through the end of November and can be canceled anytime with 30 days' notice. Corporate packages for companies with ten or more employees are also available; contact our membership team at corporate@riverstonefit.com for a customized quote.

Visit us during opening week for a free day pass, a tour of the facility, and a chance to win a one-year membership in our daily prize drawing. Doors open at 6 A.M. on weekdays and 8 A.M. on weekends.

questions.question: What is being advertised?
options: A renovated swimming pool
A newly opening fitness center
A personal training certification course
A juice bar franchise opportunity
questions.explanation: 광고는 11월 1일에 개장하는 Riverstone Fitness Club의 그랜드 오픈을 알리고 시설과 개장 기념 혜택을 소개하고 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 수영장과 주스 바는 시설의 일부일 뿐입니다.

questions.question: Who is eligible for the 20 percent discount?
options: Anyone who visits during opening week
The first 100 people to buy an annual membership in person
Employees of companies with ten or more workers
Customers who sign up online before November 1
questions.explanation: 20% 할인과 무료 PT 3회는 11월 1일~15일에 클럽에서 직접(in person) 연간 회원권을 구매하는 선착순 100명에게만 제공됩니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 온라인 가입은 해당되지 않습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the monthly plan?
options: It includes free personal training sessions.
It requires a one-year commitment.

NOTICE TO ALL RESIDENTS — MAPLECREST APARTMENTS

Scheduled Water Shutoff: Tuesday, July 15

Please be advised that the water supply to Buildings A and B will be shut off on Tuesday, July 15, from 9:00 A.M. to approximately 3:00 P.M. while contractors replace the aging main valve in the basement of Building A. Building C will not be affected.

During the shutoff, no tap water will be available in the affected buildings, and residents are advised to store water for drinking and washing in advance. The fitness room showers in Building C will remain open all day, and bottled water will be available free of charge at the management office, limited to two bottles per apartment.

When service resumes, residents may notice cloudy or discolored water for a short period. This is normal after valve work; simply run your cold-water taps for three to five minutes until the water runs clear. If discoloration continues beyond Wednesday morning, please report it to the maintenance line at extension 511.

We have scheduled this work for a weekday to minimize disruption, as our records show building occupancy is lowest at that time. The replacement is part of a larger plumbing upgrade that will continue through August; notices for future work will be posted at least one week in advance.

Thank you for your cooperation.
Maplecrest Property Management

Calloway Museum to Reopen After Renovation

SILVERTON (March 3) — After fourteen months of renovation work, the Calloway Museum of Regional History will reopen to the public on April 9. The $6.2 million project, funded largely by a grant from the Hartwell Foundation, added a climate-controlled storage facility, an expanded children's discovery room, and a glass-walled café overlooking Riverside Park. Museum director Evelyn Cho said the renovation also addressed long-standing accessibility issues. "Every gallery is now reachable by elevator, and we have added audio guides in five languages," she said. To mark the reopening, the museum will waive admission fees during the first weekend and host a series of talks by local historians. Attendance at the museum had declined steadily before the closure, falling from 95,000 annual visitors in 2019 to just 61,000 in 2023. Ms. Cho is optimistic that the new amenities will reverse that trend. "Our goal is to welcome 100,000 visitors in our first full year back," she said. The museum will be open Tuesday through Sunday, and admission will remain free for children under twelve.

passage:
Vertical Farms Take Root in Urban Warehouses

Once dismissed as an expensive experiment, vertical farming is becoming a practical part of the food supply in several large cities. GreenAxis Farms, which converted a former appliance warehouse in Deltona into a four-story growing facility two years ago, now supplies lettuce, basil, and kale to more than sixty restaurants and a regional supermarket chain. Because crops are grown indoors under LED lights, the farm operates year-round regardless of weather and uses about ninety percent less water than conventional outdoor fields. Produce also travels shorter distances; deliveries reach most customers within hours of harvest. Nonetheless, challenges remain. Electricity accounts for nearly a third of GreenAxis's operating costs, and the company has so far limited production to leafy greens, which grow quickly and command relatively high prices. "Grains and root vegetables simply are not profitable indoors yet," said operations manager Felix Marsh. The company is testing solar panels on the warehouse roof to lower its utility expenses. If the trial succeeds, GreenAxis plans to open two additional facilities in neighboring states by 2028.

Q: How can I track my package?
A: Enter your twelve-digit tracking number on our Track a Package page. Tracking information is updated every two hours. If your number does not work, please wait until the evening of the day your package was shipped, as new shipments may take up to twelve hours to appear in our system.

MEMO

To: All department heads
From: Curtis Ohlsson, Chief Financial Officer
Date: October 1
Subject: New expense reporting procedure

Effective November 1, all employee expense reports must be submitted through ClearLedger, the online platform we have adopted to replace paper forms. This change follows a three-month pilot in the sales department, during which reimbursement processing time fell from an average of eighteen days to five.

Under the new procedure, employees will photograph receipts with the ClearLedger mobile application at the time of purchase. The application automatically records the date, amount, and vendor, and assigns the expense to the correct project code. Department heads will receive reports for approval electronically and may approve or return them from any device. Once approved, reimbursements will be deposited directly into employee bank accounts within five business days.

Please note two important points. First, paper expense forms will no longer be accepted after October 31, with no exceptions. Second, employees must still retain original receipts for purchases over $500 and forward them to the accounting office, as required by our auditors.

Training webinars will be held on October 9, 15, and 22 at 2:00 P.M.; attendance at one session is mandatory for anyone who submits or approves expenses. Recordings will be available afterward on the intranet, but viewing a recording does not replace the attendance requirement.

A trial showed the new system processed payments much faster.

The old platform's contract is expiring.

To: All staff, Brennan Publishing House
From: Theo Lindqvist, Sustainability Committee Chair
Date: June 9
Subject: Energy conservation measures, beginning July 1

Following the board's approval of our sustainability plan last quarter, the following measures will take effect on July 1. Our goal is to reduce the building's electricity use by fifteen percent within one year.

1. Lighting. Motion-activated sensors will be installed in all meeting rooms, storage areas, and restrooms during the last two weeks of June. Overhead lights in open work areas will switch off automatically at 8:00 P.M.; employees working later can turn them back on using the wall panels by the elevators.

2. Equipment. All printers and copiers will enter sleep mode after ten minutes of inactivity. Staff are asked to shut down desktop computers at the end of each day rather than leaving them in standby. Laptops should be unplugged once fully charged.

3. Climate control. From July through September, office temperatures will be set at 25°C, one degree higher than in previous summers. Personal electric fans are permitted; personal space heaters and coolers are not.

The committee will publish monthly updates on our intranet page showing the building's electricity consumption compared with last year. The department that achieves the largest reduction by December 31 will receive a catered lunch. Suggestions are welcome at sustainability@brennanpub.com.

From: Yuna Choi <y.choi@kestrelmotors.com>
Date: April 17
Subject: Quality concern — Order #KM-5582

Dear Mr. Bell,

I am writing regarding the shipment of steel hinge brackets we received from Torvil Fasteners on April 14 (Order #KM-5582). During our routine incoming inspection, our quality team found that approximately 8 percent of the brackets in the batch fell outside the agreed thickness tolerance of 2.5 millimeters, plus or minus 0.1 millimeters. Under the terms of our supply agreement, the acceptable defect rate is no more than 2 percent.

We have set aside the nonconforming parts and can return them at your expense, or your technicians are welcome to examine them at our facility in Granton. Because these brackets are needed for an assembly run scheduled to start on April 28, we would ask that replacement parts be delivered no later than April 25.

Please also send a corrective action report describing how the issue occurred and what steps will be taken to prevent it. We value our four-year partnership with Torvil and trust this matter can be resolved quickly.

Sincerely,
Yuna Choi
Purchasing Manager, Kestrel Motors

To report defective parts in a recent delivery
To request a price quote for steel brackets
To schedule a tour of a production facility
questions.explanation: 이메일 첫 문단에서 4월 14일에 받은 브래킷 중 약 8퍼센트가 합의된 두께 허용 오차를 벗어났다고 알리고 있으므로, 최근 납품된 부품의 불량을 보고하는 것이 발송 목적입니다. 계약 해지나 견적 요청, 시설 견학 일정은 언급되지 않았습니다.

Subject: Updated protective equipment requirements

Following last month's safety audit, Brennan Metalworks is updating its personal protective equipment policy, effective September 15. The audit found that while compliance with hard hat and steel-toed boot requirements was excellent, eye protection practices were inconsistent, particularly in the welding bays.

Beginning September 15, all personnel entering the welding bays—including visitors and office staff—must wear the new full-coverage safety goggles rather than standard safety glasses. The goggles will be distributed at the equipment counter starting September 8; please bring your employee badge to receive your pair. Prescription lens wearers should see Ms. Okada in Human Resources by September 5 so that fitted goggles can be ordered in time.

In addition, hearing protection will now be mandatory in the stamping area whenever the presses are in operation, not only during extended shifts as before. Disposable earplugs will remain available at all entrances, and reusable earmuffs may be requested from your supervisor.

Supervisors will review the updated policy at next week's toolbox talks. Repeated noncompliance will be documented and may affect annual performance evaluations.

MEMO

To: All Warehouse Staff, Norvale Distribution Center
From: Tomasz Krupa, Inventory Control Manager
Date: January 8
Subject: New cycle counting procedure

Starting February 1, the Norvale Distribution Center will replace its annual full-facility inventory count with a cycle counting program. Instead of closing the warehouse for two days each December, small sections of inventory will be counted continuously throughout the year.

Under the new system, each aisle will be counted at least once per quarter. High-value items, such as electronics stored in the secured cage, will be counted monthly. Counts will take place during the first hour of the morning shift, before order picking begins, to minimize disruption.

A team of six staff members will be designated as cycle counters on a rotating basis. Counters will use the handheld scanners already in use for receiving; a software update enabling the counting module will be installed on January 25. A mandatory forty-five-minute orientation will be held in the break room on January 28 at 8:00 A.M. and repeated at 2:30 P.M. for the afternoon shift.

This change should improve inventory accuracy, reduce year-end overtime costs, and help us identify discrepancies before they affect customer orders. Questions may be directed to me at extension 4471.

options: A change in how inventory is counted
The installation of new security cameras
A reduction in warehouse operating hours
The hiring of seasonal warehouse workers
questions.explanation: 메모는 연 1회 전체 재고 조사를 연중 순환 실사(cycle counting) 방식으로 바꾼다는 내용을 중심으로 새 절차, 일정, 교육을 안내하고 있습니다. 보안 카메라, 운영 시간 단축, 계절 인력 채용은 언급되지 않았습니다.

Salome Diallo
Director of Procurement

To: All Delivery Drivers and Dock Personnel
From: Ingrid Solberg, Terminal Operations Manager
Date: May 12
Subject: Revised check-in procedure at Gate 4

Effective Monday, May 19, all inbound trucks at the Harwick Terminal must check in at the new automated kiosk at Gate 4. The kiosk replaces the paper sign-in sheets previously kept in the dispatch office and is intended to shorten wait times during the morning rush, when as many as thirty trucks arrive between 6:00 and 8:00 A.M.

To check in, drivers should scan the QR code on their delivery manifest, enter their trailer number, and select an available dock door from the on-screen list. The kiosk will print a dock assignment slip, which must be displayed on the dashboard while the vehicle is on terminal property. Drivers without a printed manifest can enter their booking reference manually, though this takes slightly longer.

Dock personnel should note that door assignments will now appear automatically on the warehouse display boards; radio confirmation from dispatch is no longer required, except for oversized loads and refrigerated trailers, which still need manual assignment.

During the first two weeks, a dispatcher will be stationed at Gate 4 from 5:30 A.M. to 9:00 A.M. to assist drivers unfamiliar with the system. Comments about the new procedure may be left in the suggestion box outside the drivers' lounge.

To monitor driver working hours
To replace the warehouse display boards
To collect terminal entrance fees

A booking confirmation email

Concrete work. Worker safety. When the wind chill drops below minus fifteen, outdoor crews must be offered a ten-minute warming break every hour in the heated site trailer. Snow removal. Each site must designate a snow contractor by November 28 and post the contractor's emergency number in the site office. Access roads, scaffold platforms, and walkways must be cleared and salted before crews begin work, and any delay caused by snow clearing should be coded as weather time, not productive hours, in the timesheet system.

The full protocol document is on the company portal under Safety > Seasonal. Confirm by reply that your site is prepared.

Olivia Marchetti

Temperature logs. The refrigerator and freezer temperatures in the medication room must be recorded twice daily—once at opening and once before 4:00 P.M. Copying this information later from the prep-room whiteboard is error-prone; two December entries showed lot numbers that did not match any vaccine in our inventory.

Spoilage reporting. Any dose drawn but not administered—for example, when a patient declines at the last moment—must be logged on the wastage form within one hour, not at the end of the week as some staff believed. Accurate wastage data affects our vaccine allocation from the county for next season.

Ms. Okonkwo will hold two fifteen-minute refresher huddles on January 22, at 7:45 A.M. and 3:15 P.M.; attendance at one is required. Thank you for your attention to these details.

Subject: Water restrictions and revised irrigation schedule

The Brackenfield Water Authority has placed our district under Stage 2 drought restrictions effective July 28. For agricultural users, this means a 20 percent reduction in metered water use compared with last July, with penalties of up to $5,000 for exceeding the allowance. The following measures will keep us within our limit while protecting the crops that matter most.

The drip lines in tomato houses 1 through 4 will switch to night operation, running from 10:00 P.M. to 4:00 A.M., when evaporation is lowest. Overhead sprinklers in the outdoor lettuce beds will run on alternating days only; field staff should check soil moisture probes each morning and report readings below 30 percent to their team lead rather than watering by hand, since hand watering is hard to meter and counts against our allowance.

The seedling nursery is exempt from the reductions, as young plants cannot tolerate water stress; its usage will be offset by deeper cuts elsewhere, primarily by pausing irrigation of the ornamental beds near the visitor entrance for the duration of the restrictions.

Maintenance staff will inspect all drip lines for leaks this week; last summer, a single cracked junction wasted an estimated 9,000 liters before it was found. Anyone noticing wet patches, hissing sounds, or unusually low line pressure should report them to me immediately at extension 240.

These measures will be reviewed if the Authority changes the restriction level.

Linnea Sandberg

To: Hollis Park Project Team <hollispark@dunmorecivil.com>
From: Tobias Reinholt <t.reinholt@dunmorecivil.com>
Date: May 30
Subject: Material substitution approval — retaining wall blocks

Dear Team,

This email confirms the outcome of yesterday's discussion with the client and the structural engineer regarding the retaining wall along the eastern edge of the Hollis Park site.

As you know, our specified supplier, Keystone Precast, notified us on May 22 that the approved W-40 wall blocks are backordered until mid-August because of a kiln failure at their plant. Waiting would push the wall completion past the July 31 milestone, which carries a contractual penalty of $1,200 per day. We therefore requested approval to substitute the V-38 block from Borchert Concrete Products, which is available for delivery within two weeks.

The structural engineer has now reviewed Borchert's test certificates and confirmed the V-38 meets or exceeds the specified compressive strength and freeze-thaw durability ratings. The client signed the substitution form this morning, with one condition: because the V-38 has a slightly different surface texture, a sample panel of at least two square meters must be built and photographed for the client's records before full installation begins. Mr. Castellanos, please schedule this panel for the week of June 9 and invite the client's representative to view it in person.

The substitution saves us from the delay penalty, and Borchert's unit price is actually 3 percent lower, though increased delivery distance will absorb most of that difference. Please update the procurement log and the as-built drawings accordingly.

Regards,
Tobias Reinholt
Project Manager, Dunmore Civil Engineering

Begin preparing application documents
Send a copy of his photo ID to the doorman
Contact the owner of the apartment

passage:
Priya Anand (4:02 P.M.)
Hi all. Final headcount for Saturday's riverbank cleanup: 67 volunteers signed up. That's nearly double last year!

Sam Kowalski (4:05 P.M.)
Wonderful news, but we only reserved 40 trash grabbers and 40 pairs of gloves from the parks department.

Noor Haddad (4:07 P.M.)
I can ask my employer. Crestline Hardware donated buckets for the spring event, and my manager mentioned wanting to do more community sponsorship.

Priya Anand (4:09 P.M.)
That would be fantastic, Noor. We'd need at least 30 more grabbers and gloves. Could you find out by tomorrow evening? The shuttle schedule has to be finalized by Thursday too.

Sam Kowalski (4:11 P.M.)
About the shuttle — with 67 people, one bus won't be enough. The rental company quoted $180 for a second bus.

Noor Haddad (4:13 P.M.)
Don't book it yet. At least twenty volunteers are from Westside College, and their environmental club has its own van pool.

Sam Kowalski (4:14 P.M.)
Good point. I'll contact the club president and confirm how many seats they can cover before we spend anything.

Priya Anand (4:16 P.M.)
Perfect. Let's regroup here tomorrow at 5:00 P.M. I'll bring the updated budget sheet.

questions.question: What event are the writers organizing?
options: A hardware store's spring sale
A college club's fund-raiser
A community trash-collection event
A bus tour along a river
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지의 'Final headcount for Saturday's riverbank cleanup: 67 volunteers signed up'에서 강변 청소 행사를 준비하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 자원봉사자들이 참여하는 지역사회 쓰레기 수거(청소) 행사이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Kowalski mention at 4:05 P.M.?
options: Fewer volunteers registered than last year.
The parks department canceled a reservation.
Some supplies were damaged at a spring event.
Not enough equipment has been reserved.
questions.explanation: 4:05 P.M.에 Sam은 'we only reserved 40 trash grabbers and 40 pairs of gloves'라고 말합니다. 자원봉사자가 67명인데 집게와 장갑은 40개씩만 예약되어 있어 장비가 부족하다는 문제를 지적한 것이므로 (D)가 정답입니다. 참가자는 작년의 거의 두 배로 늘었으므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: At 4:13 P.M., what does Ms. Haddad most likely mean when she writes, "Don't book it yet"?
options: A second bus may turn out to be unnecessary.
The rental company's price is too high.
The shuttle schedule has not been approved.
The budget sheet must be updated first.
questions.explanation: Sam이 두 번째 버스 대여에 $180가 든다고 하자 Noor는 'Don't book it yet. At least twenty volunteers are from Westside College, and their environmental club has its own van pool'이라고 답합니다. 대학 환경 동아리의 밴을 이용할 수 있으면 두 번째 버스가 필요 없을 수도 있으니 아직 예약하지 말라는 의미입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Anand most likely do before tomorrow's discussion?
options: Contact a club president
Revise a financial document
Reserve a second shuttle bus
Visit Crestline Hardware
questions.explanation: 4:16 P.M.에 Priya는 'Let's regroup here tomorrow at 5:00 P.M. I'll bring the updated budget sheet'라고 말합니다. 내일 논의 전에 예산표를 갱신(수정)해 올 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 동아리 회장 연락은 Sam, Crestline Hardware 문의는 Noor의 일입니다.

passage:
Owen Mercer (9:05 A.M.)
Good morning. This is Owen Mercer from Stonebridge Films. The generator we rented from you yesterday keeps shutting off after about twenty minutes of use.

Fiona Gallagher (9:08 A.M.)
Sorry to hear that, Mr. Mercer. That model has an automatic cutoff when it overheats. Is it placed somewhere with enough airflow?

Owen Mercer (9:10 A.M.)
It's in an open field with nothing around it. We're filming today until sunset, and the lighting rig depends on it.

Fiona Gallagher (9:12 A.M.)
Understood. Then it's likely a faulty cooling fan. We can swap it for the same model, or upgrade you to the G-90, which has double the output. The G-90 normally costs $40 more per day.

Owen Mercer (9:14 A.M.)
We've already lost a morning of shooting.

Fiona Gallagher (9:16 A.M.)
Fair enough — we'll waive the upgrade fee for the rest of your rental period. Our driver can be at your site in Millbrook by 10:30. Will someone be there to sign for it?

Owen Mercer (9:18 A.M.)
Our production assistant, Kira Slade, will meet the driver at the front gate. Should she hand over the faulty unit at the same time?

Fiona Gallagher (9:19 A.M.)
Yes, please. And I'll e-mail you a revised invoice this afternoon reflecting the change.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Mr. Mercer's first message?
options: To report a problem with rented equipment
To extend a rental agreement by one day
To ask for directions to a filming site
To request a copy of an invoice
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 Owen은 'The generator we rented from you yesterday keeps shutting off after about twenty minutes of use'라고 말합니다. 대여한 발전기가 계속 꺼지는 문제를 알리기 위한 메시지이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Gallagher think is wrong with the generator?
options: It was placed in an area with poor airflow.
Its cooling fan is defective.
Its output is too low for a lighting rig.
It was not refueled before delivery.
questions.explanation: 발전기가 사방이 트인 들판에 있다는 말을 듣고 Fiona는 9:12 A.M.에 'Then it's likely a faulty cooling fan'이라고 말합니다. 냉각 팬 불량이 원인일 가능성이 높다고 판단하므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 통풍 문제는 가능성으로 물었다가 배제되었습니다.

questions.question: At 9:14 A.M., why does Mr. Mercer write, "We've already lost a morning of shooting"?
options: To explain why filming will continue past sunset
To suggest that he should not pay extra for an upgrade
To complain that the driver arrived late
To request a refund for the entire rental
questions.explanation: Fiona가 'The G-90 normally costs $40 more per day'라며 추가 요금이 드는 업그레이드를 제안하자 Owen은 'We've already lost a morning of shooting'(이미 오전 촬영을 날렸다)이라고 답합니다. 장비 결함으로 손해를 봤으니 업그레이드 추가 요금을 내는 것은 부당하다는 뜻을 내비친 것이며, 실제로 Fiona가 'we'll waive the upgrade fee'라고 요금을 면제해 줍니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is Ms. Slade expected to do?
options: E-mail a revised invoice to Ms. Gallagher
Drive the replacement generator to Millbrook
Repair the cooling fan at the front gate
Receive a delivery and return the broken unit
questions.explanation: 9:18 A.M.에 Owen은 'Our production assistant, Kira Slade, will meet the driver at the front gate. Should she hand over the faulty unit at the same time?'라고 묻고 Fiona는 'Yes, please'라고 답합니다. Kira Slade는 교체 발전기를 수령하면서 고장 난 발전기를 기사에게 넘겨줄 것이므로 (D)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Hannah Voss (1:10 P.M.)
Hi Mr. Tanaka, thanks for sending over the brief for the Solara product brochure. I've reviewed it and have a few questions before I send a formal quote.

Kenji Tanaka (1:14 P.M.)
Of course. Ask away.

Hannah Voss (1:16 P.M.)
The brief mentions twelve pages of layout design, but it also says "copywriting as needed." Does your team provide the text, or am I writing it as well?

Kenji Tanaka (1:19 P.M.)
Our marketing team will supply about half. We'd need you to write the product descriptions — roughly 800 words total.

Hannah Voss (1:22 P.M.)
Got it. With copywriting included, my estimate is $2,400, delivered in three weeks. Design only would be $1,800.

Kenji Tanaka (1:26 P.M.)
Our budget for this brochure is capped at $2,000. Could we do design only, with two rounds of revisions included?

Hannah Voss (1:29 P.M.)
My standard contract includes one round. A second round would be $150, so $1,950 total. That keeps you under the cap.

Kenji Tanaka (1:31 P.M.)
You've done the math for me. Send the contract over.

Hannah Voss (1:33 P.M.)
Wonderful. You'll have it by end of day, along with my updated portfolio link. Once it's signed, the three-week clock starts.

questions.question: Who most likely is Ms. Voss?
options: A marketing manager at Solara
A freelance designer
A printing company representative
An accountant reviewing a budget
questions.explanation: Hannah는 안내 책자(brochure)의 레이아웃 디자인과 카피라이팅에 대한 견적('my estimate is $2,400')과 자신의 표준 계약('My standard contract includes one round'), 포트폴리오('my updated portfolio link')를 언급합니다. 클라이언트인 Tanaka에게 직접 견적과 계약서를 보내는 것으로 보아 프리랜서 디자이너이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Voss ask about the project brief?
options: Whether she is responsible for writing some text
Whether the brochure can be reduced to twelve pages
Whether the deadline can be extended to three weeks
Whether the marketing team approved her portfolio
questions.explanation: 1:16 P.M.에 Hannah는 'Does your team provide the text, or am I writing it as well?'라고 묻습니다. 브리프의 'copywriting as needed'라는 문구와 관련해 자신이 글(카피)까지 써야 하는지 확인하는 것이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How much will Mr. Tanaka's company most likely pay for the project?
questions.explanation: Hannah는 디자인만 하면 $1,800, 두 번째 수정 1회 추가 시 $150를 더해 'so $1,950 total'이라고 제시했고, Kenji는 'Send the contract over'라고 수락합니다. 최종 합의 금액은 $1,950이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. $2,000는 예산 상한, $2,400는 카피라이팅 포함 견적입니다.

questions.question: At 1:31 P.M., what does Mr. Tanaka most likely mean when he writes, "You've done the math for me"?
options: He needs help calculating his marketing budget.
He is pleased that the proposal fits within his limit.
He believes the invoice contains an error.
He wants Ms. Voss to recalculate her estimate.
questions.explanation: Hannah가 수정 2회를 포함해 $1,950로 'That keeps you under the cap'(상한선 아래로 맞춰진다)라고 계산해 주자, Kenji는 'You've done the math for me. Send the contract over'라고 답합니다. 자신이 따져 볼 것도 없이 예산 상한($2,000) 안에 맞는 제안을 정리해 줘서 만족스럽다는 의미이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 곧바로 계약서를 보내 달라고 한 것이 이를 뒷받침합니다.

passage:
Marta Jensen (10:30 A.M.)
Mr. Okafor, this is Marta from Velvet Fork Catering. I'm confirming Friday's lunch order: 45 boxed meals, delivery to Harlan Tower at 11:45 A.M.

Chidi Okafor (10:37 A.M.)
Actually, I was about to call you. Our seminar registration jumped this week. We now expect 62 attendees.

Marta Jensen (10:40 A.M.)
We can scale up to 62 boxes, but our kitchen needs final numbers by Wednesday at 3:00 P.M. for orders over 50. Also, were the dietary ratios the same? You originally had eight vegetarian and three gluten-free.

Chidi Okafor (10:44 A.M.)
Let me check the registration list. Some new sign-ups noted preferences. Give me an hour.

Marta Jensen (10:45 A.M.)
No problem. One more thing — Harlan Tower's loading dock is being repaved this week. Our driver was told to use the Pine Street entrance instead. Could you arrange for someone to meet her there?

Chidi Okafor (11:52 A.M.)
Done — our intern Felix will wait at Pine Street from 11:30. And the final count: 62 meals, eleven vegetarian, five gluten-free.

Marta Jensen (11:55 A.M.)
Perfect, you beat the deadline with a day to spare. I'll send the revised invoice and a delivery confirmation tonight.

questions.question: Why did Mr. Okafor want to contact Ms. Jensen?
options: To cancel a catering order
To increase the size of an order
To complain about a late delivery
To ask about vegetarian recipes
questions.explanation: 10:37 A.M.에 Chidi는 'I was about to call you. Our seminar registration jumped this week. We now expect 62 attendees'라고 말합니다. 세미나 등록자가 늘어 45개였던 도시락 주문을 62개로 늘리려고 연락하려던 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why must the driver use the Pine Street entrance?
options: The loading dock is under repair.
The main lobby is reserved for attendees.
Parking is not allowed near Harlan Tower.
The delivery is scheduled before the building opens.
questions.explanation: 10:45 A.M.에 Marta는 'Harlan Tower's loading dock is being repaved this week. Our driver was told to use the Pine Street entrance instead'라고 말합니다. 하역장이 재포장 공사 중이라 Pine Street 입구를 이용해야 하므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What will Felix most likely do on Friday?
options: Repave a loading dock
Distribute seminar registration forms
Meet a delivery driver at an entrance
Prepare eleven vegetarian meals
questions.explanation: Marta가 'Could you arrange for someone to meet her there?'라고 부탁하자 Chidi는 'our intern Felix will wait at Pine Street from 11:30'이라고 답합니다. 인턴 Felix가 Pine Street 입구에서 배달 기사를 맞이할 것이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 11:55 A.M., what does Ms. Jensen most likely mean when she writes, "you beat the deadline with a day to spare"?
options: Mr. Okafor confirmed his numbers earlier than required.
Mr. Okafor's seminar will end a day earlier than planned.
The kitchen finished preparing the meals ahead of schedule.
The invoice will arrive one day before the event.
questions.explanation: Marta는 50개 초과 주문의 최종 수량 마감이 'Wednesday at 3:00 P.M.'이라고 안내했는데, Chidi가 그보다 하루 이상 앞서(대화 당일) 최종 수량(62개, 채식 11, 글루텐프리 5)을 확정해 주었습니다. 'you beat the deadline with a day to spare'는 마감보다 하루 여유 있게 일찍 확정했다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Gloria Mensah (2:15 P.M.)
Team, the quarterly count in Aisle 14 shows 96 ceramic planters, but the system says we should have 120. That's two full cases missing.

Victor Aleman (2:18 P.M.)
Did anyone check the returns area? A shipment came back from the Lakeside store on Monday, and some of it hasn't been processed yet.

Gloria Mensah (2:20 P.M.)
Good thought. Dee, you logged the Lakeside return, right?

Dee Park (2:24 P.M.)
I logged the boxes that arrived, but two pallets were sent straight to the overflow trailer because Receiving was full. I haven't opened those yet.

Victor Aleman (2:26 P.M.)
There's our answer, probably. Lakeside's return list included planters — I remember because the driver mentioned how heavy they were.

Gloria Mensah (2:28 P.M.)
Dee, can you check the trailer before the end of your shift? If the planters are there, scan them in right away. The auditors arrive Thursday morning, and every aisle count needs to match the system by Wednesday night.

Dee Park (2:30 P.M.)
Heading there now. If they're not in the trailer, I'll pull the security footage from the dock for Monday.

Gloria Mensah (2:31 P.M.)
Let's hope it doesn't come to that. Report back here either way.

questions.question: What problem is being discussed?
options: A store shipment arrived damaged.
An inventory count does not match records.
A security camera has stopped working.
An aisle was left unstocked before an audit.
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 Gloria는 'the quarterly count in Aisle 14 shows 96 ceramic planters, but the system says we should have 120'이라고 말합니다. 실사 수량(96개)과 시스템 기록(120개)이 일치하지 않는 재고 불일치 문제를 논의하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to Ms. Park, why were some pallets placed in a trailer?
options: They were scheduled for delivery to Lakeside.
They contained damaged merchandise.
There was no space in the receiving area.
The auditors requested separate storage.
questions.explanation: 2:24 P.M.에 Dee는 'two pallets were sent straight to the overflow trailer because Receiving was full'이라고 설명합니다. 입고 구역(Receiving)이 가득 차서 팰릿 두 개를 보조 트레일러로 보낸 것이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 2:26 P.M., what does Mr. Aleman most likely mean when he writes, "There's our answer, probably"?
options: The missing planters are likely in the unopened pallets.
The system count was probably entered incorrectly.
The driver most likely delivered to the wrong store.
The security footage will explain the discrepancy.
questions.explanation: Dee가 Lakeside 반품 중 팰릿 두 개를 아직 열지 않은 채 트레일러에 두었다고 하자 Victor는 'There's our answer, probably. Lakeside's return list included planters'라고 말합니다. 반품 목록에 화분이 있었으므로 사라진 화분들이 그 미개봉 팰릿 안에 있을 가능성이 높다는 의미입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does the count need to be corrected by Wednesday night?
options: A new shipment will arrive on Thursday.
An inspection is scheduled for Thursday morning.
Ms. Park's shift ends on Wednesday.
The overflow trailer must be returned by Thursday.
questions.explanation: 2:28 P.M.에 Gloria는 'The auditors arrive Thursday morning, and every aisle count needs to match the system by Wednesday night'라고 말합니다. 목요일 아침 감사관(auditors)의 점검이 있어서 수요일 밤까지 수량을 맞춰야 하므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Isabel Romero (9:00 A.M.)
Moving day update: the truck is loaded and leaving the old office now. Estimated arrival at the Concord Building is 9:45.

Tom Whitaker (9:03 A.M.)
Small hitch on this end. The freight elevator is reserved by another tenant until 10:30. The building manager won't budge.

Isabel Romero (9:05 A.M.)
That's a forty-five-minute gap. The movers bill by the hour.

Lucy Chen (9:07 A.M.)
What about the boxes for the fifth floor? Those are mostly files and desk supplies — light enough for the regular elevators, if we carry them in small loads.

Tom Whitaker (9:09 A.M.)
Building rules allow that, as long as we use the protective pads in the elevator cars. I'll grab them from the manager's office.

Isabel Romero (9:11 A.M.)
Great. So the crew starts with fifth-floor boxes at 9:45, then switches to furniture once the freight elevator frees up. Lucy, can you label which boxes are elevator-safe before they arrive?

Lucy Chen (9:13 A.M.)
Already on it. Green stickers for light boxes, red for anything that waits for the freight elevator.

Tom Whitaker (9:14 A.M.)
And I'll print two floor maps showing where each department's boxes go, and tape them up by both elevator banks.

questions.question: What are the writers mainly discussing?
options: Hiring a moving company
Handling a delay during an office move
Negotiating a lease with a building manager
Rearranging furniture on the fifth floor
questions.explanation: 트럭이 9:45에 도착하는데 화물 엘리베이터는 10:30까지 다른 입주사가 예약해 둔 상황에서, 가벼운 상자를 일반 엘리베이터로 먼저 나르는 등 사무실 이사 중의 지연 문제를 어떻게 처리할지 논의하고 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 이사업체 고용은 이미 끝난 일입니다.

questions.question: At 9:05 A.M., what does Ms. Romero most likely mean when she writes, "The movers bill by the hour"?
options: Waiting for the freight elevator will cost extra money.
The moving company is more expensive than expected.
The crew should take an hour-long break at 10:30.
The invoice from the movers contains an error.
questions.explanation: Tom이 화물 엘리베이터를 10:30까지 쓸 수 없다고 하자 Isabel은 'That's a forty-five-minute gap. The movers bill by the hour'라고 답합니다. 이사업체가 시간당 요금을 청구하므로 45분을 그냥 기다리면 추가 비용이 발생한다는 우려를 표현한 것입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답이며, 이후 대기 시간에 가벼운 상자를 나르는 대안이 논의됩니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the regular elevators?
options: They are reserved until 10:30.
They may be used if padding is installed.
They cannot reach the fifth floor.
They are located next to the manager's office.
questions.explanation: 9:09 A.M.에 Tom은 'Building rules allow that, as long as we use the protective pads in the elevator cars'라고 말합니다. 보호 패드를 설치하면 일반 엘리베이터로 상자를 나를 수 있다는 건물 규정을 언급한 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 10:30까지 예약된 것은 화물 엘리베이터입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Whitaker offer to do?
options: Put colored stickers on the boxes
Ask the building manager to change a reservation
Post maps near the elevators
Carry furniture up to the fifth floor
questions.explanation: 9:14 A.M.에 Tom은 'I'll print two floor maps showing where each department's boxes go, and tape them up by both elevator banks'라고 말합니다. 각 부서 상자의 위치를 표시한 평면도를 인쇄해 양쪽 엘리베이터 옆에 붙이겠다는 것이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 스티커 부착은 Lucy의 일입니다.

passage:
Nadia Petrova (6:20 P.M.)
Hi Mr. Boateng. I'm scheduled to pick you up from Hartfield Airport tomorrow for the Innovation Summit. Has your flight time changed at all?

Kwame Boateng (6:34 P.M.)
Good timing — yes, unfortunately. My connection in Chicago was canceled, and the airline rebooked me on a flight landing at 11:50 A.M. instead of 9:15.

Nadia Petrova (6:37 P.M.)
Oh no. Your keynote is at 1:00 P.M., and the venue is about fifty minutes from the airport in midday traffic.

Kwame Boateng (6:40 P.M.)
That's cutting it close. Is there any flexibility in the program?

Nadia Petrova (6:44 P.M.)

passage:
Leandro Costa (9:40 A.M.)

passage:
Library Renovation Chat

passage:
HARLOW VALLEY (June 2) — Brightbean Coffee, the popular café chain headquartered in Marston, announced yesterday that it will open twelve new locations across the Harlow Valley region over the next eighteen months. The expansion, the company's largest to date, is expected to create approximately 240 jobs, including baristas, shift supervisors, and regional managers.

"Harlow Valley has experienced remarkable population growth in recent years, and we believe the area can sustain a strong demand for specialty coffee," said Priya Raman, Brightbean's chief operating officer. "We have been studying this market for nearly three years, and the timing is finally right."

The first two cafés will open in downtown Eastwick and at the Harlow Valley Shopping Centre in September. Unlike the chain's existing stores, the new locations will feature an expanded food menu developed in partnership with local bakery Crowfield Ovens. Ms. Raman noted that sourcing pastries locally would reduce delivery distances and support neighborhood businesses.

Brightbean currently operates 85 cafés in four regions. Industry analyst Tomas Greer called the move "a calculated risk," pointing out that two competing chains already have a solid footing in the valley. Nevertheless, Brightbean's stock rose three percent following the announcement.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the article?
options: To review the quality of a café's new menu
To report on a company's planned expansion
To announce the merger of two coffee chains
To profile a newly appointed executive
questions.explanation: 기사 첫 문단에서 Brightbean Coffee가 Harlow Valley 지역에 18개월간 12개 신규 매장을 연다는 확장 계획을 발표했다고 보도하고 있습니다. 메뉴 평가(A), 합병(C), 임원 소개(D)는 기사의 핵심 내용이 아니므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the article, what will be different about the new locations?
options: They will be open 24 hours a day
They will offer a wider selection of food
They will be staffed entirely by local residents
They will serve coffee grown in Harlow Valley
questions.explanation: 세 번째 문단에서 신규 매장은 기존 매장과 달리(unlike the chain's existing stores) 지역 베이커리 Crowfield Ovens와 협력해 개발한 확장된 음식 메뉴(expanded food menu)를 제공한다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 24시간 영업, 전원 지역 주민 채용, 지역산 커피에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: The word "sustain" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
options: suffer
support
delay
imitate
questions.explanation: "the area can sustain a strong demand for specialty coffee"에서 sustain은 수요를 '유지하다, 지탱하다'라는 의미로 쓰였습니다. 따라서 '뒷받침하다, 지탱하다'라는 뜻의 support가 가장 가깝습니다. suffer(겪다), delay(지연시키다), imitate(모방하다)는 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the Harlow Valley coffee market?
options: It already has established competitors
It has been shrinking for three years
It is dominated by Crowfield Ovens
It lacks qualified café workers
questions.explanation: 마지막 문단에서 애널리스트 Tomas Greer가 두 개의 경쟁 체인이 이미 이 지역에 확고한 기반(solid footing)을 갖고 있다고 지적했으므로, 기존 경쟁자가 존재한다는 (A)가 정답입니다. 시장 축소나 인력 부족에 대한 언급은 없으며 Crowfield Ovens는 베이커리 협력사입니다.

passage:
PORT ANDERS (May 14) — Two of the region's largest freight companies, Calloway Transport and Nordvik Shipping, confirmed on Tuesday that they will merge to form a single carrier, to be called Calloway Nordvik Logistics. — [1] —. The combined company will operate a fleet of more than 600 trucks and 14 cargo vessels, making it the second-largest freight operator on the northern coast.

Executives from both firms emphasized that the merger is a response to rising fuel costs and growing competition from international carriers. — [2] —. "By combining our route networks, we can eliminate overlapping trips and pass the savings on to customers," said Calloway president Dana Whitfield, who will lead the new company.

Larkspur will publish a progress report every six months on its website, where customers can also find instructions for composting the plant-based film at home. The company joins a growing list of apparel brands, including Tornquist & Co. and Fellbright, that have made similar pledges in the past two years.

COMMUNITY MANAGER WANTED — THE HIVE COWORKING

The Hive, Riverton's fastest-growing coworking space, is looking for a full-time Community Manager to be the welcoming face of our Quarry Street location.

As Community Manager, you will greet members and visitors, coordinate the weekly networking breakfast, manage meeting-room bookings, respond to member inquiries, and organize two member events each month. You will also give tours to prospective members and assist the operations team with billing questions.

The ideal candidate has at least two years of customer service or hospitality experience, strong written communication skills, and basic familiarity with spreadsheet software. Experience in event planning is a plus. A flexible schedule is essential: the position requires working one Saturday per month during open-house events.

We offer a starting salary of $42,000, fifteen paid vacation days, a public transit allowance, and a free Dedicated Desk membership for one family member. After one year of employment, staff become eligible for our professional development fund, which covers up to $1,200 in course fees annually.

Submit a résumé and a brief statement describing your approach to community building to jobs@thehiveriverton.com by June 15. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an in-person interview during the final week of June.

Beginning Monday, May 4, the museum's East Wing, which houses the Mineral and Gemstone Gallery, will be closed for a major renovation expected to last four months. During this time, approximately thirty of the collection's most popular specimens, including the celebrated Calder Sapphire, will be displayed in a temporary exhibit on the ground floor of the West Wing.

Because the East Wing entrance will be blocked by construction equipment, all visitors must enter through the main doors on Whitfield Avenue. Visitors with mobility needs may use the accessible entrance on Porter Street, where staff will be available to assist.

To apologize for the inconvenience, the museum is reducing general admission from $14 to $10 for the entire renovation period. Members, as always, enter free of charge. Guided tours of the West Wing temporary exhibit will run daily at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M. at no extra cost.

We thank you for your patience and look forward to unveiling the redesigned gallery in September.

ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS
Verano Adjustable Standing Desk — Model VD-220

Before you begin: Confirm that the carton contains the desktop panel, two leg columns, the crossbar, a control keypad, fourteen bolts, and an Allen wrench. Assembly requires two people and takes approximately 45 minutes. Do not use a power drill, as overtightening may strip the frame threads.

Step 1: Place the desktop panel facedown on a soft surface to prevent scratches.
Step 2: Attach each leg column to the underside of the panel using four bolts per column. Tighten only halfway.
Step 3: Connect the crossbar between the two columns with the remaining six bolts, then fully tighten all fourteen bolts.
Step 4: Mount the control keypad on the right front edge, or the left edge if preferred, and plug its cable into the port on the crossbar.
Step 5: With your partner, turn the desk upright and plug the power cord into a grounded outlet.

Important: Before first use, press and hold the DOWN button for ten seconds to calibrate the motor. Failure to calibrate may cause uneven lifting and will void the warranty.

Effective September 1

Glenfield Water Authority

Attention residents of the Maplewood Heights neighborhood:

Water service will be temporarily shut off on Wednesday, October 21, from 9:00 A.M. to approximately 4:00 P.M. while crews replace a sixty-year-old main valve at the intersection of Drummond Road and Pine Street. This replacement is part of a five-year infrastructure improvement plan approved by the city council last spring.

When service resumes, tap water may appear cloudy or discolored for a few hours; this is caused by harmless air and mineral particles. Conducted March 2–13 | Distributed to 480 employees; 384 responses received (80% response rate)

Primary mode of commuting:
- Driving alone: 52%
- Public transit: 24%
- Carpooling: 11%
- Cycling or walking: 9%
- Other: 4%

Key findings: Sixty-one percent of drivers said they would consider switching to public transit if the company subsidized monthly passes. Among cyclists, the most requested improvement was secure indoor bicycle storage, cited by 27 of 35 respondents. Employees commuting more than 45 minutes each way reported the lowest satisfaction with their commute.

Recommendations: The facilities committee recommends (1) negotiating a 30 percent transit pass subsidy with Metro Area Transport beginning in the next fiscal year, (2) converting the unused storage room beside the loading dock into a bicycle room with twenty racks, and (3) expanding the work-from-home option to two days per week for employees with commutes over 45 minutes. The executive board will vote on these recommendations at its May 14 meeting, and results will be announced in the June staff newsletter.
